integrity: The proof exhausts all six prime-factorization shapes with \(\Omega(n)\le3\) and reduces each to exact congruence conditions. The standalone finite verifier is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only \(\Omega(n)\le3\). It does not address higher multiplicity layers or counting asymptotics.
title: Complete first three multiplicity layers of a divisor-count divisibility
